title: aicode config
description: aicode settings: ~/.config/aicode/config.json (or -config path.json), and profile files ~/.config/aicode/<name>.json. A profile has the same keys as the top level; every key it sets replaces the top-level value as a whole (objects and arrays included).

$schema.description: Optional URL or path of this schema, for editors. aicode ignores it.

model.description: Model id sent to the API, e.g. openai/gpt-6-luna or claude-opus-5-5. Default: claude-sonnet-5-5 for api anthropic, openai/gpt-6-luna for OpenRouter, gpt-6-luna otherwise.

api.description: Wire protocol: openai (chat completions; OpenAI, OpenRouter and compatible servers) or anthropic (native Messages API). Usually set by the provider. Default: openai.

provider.description: Name of an entry in providers, or a built-in provider: claude, anthropic (api anthropic) or openai. Selecting a provider sets api, base_url, api_key, api_key_shell and cache_control from it; base_url and the other connection keys set in the same profile win over the provider's.

base_url.description: API base URL. Default: https://api.openai.com/v1 or Anthropic's; https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 when only OPENROUTER_API_KEY is set.

api_key.description: Literal API key. Prefer api_key_shell so the key stays out of the file. Without either, the key comes from OPENROUTER_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

api_key_shell.description: Shell command whose first output line is the API key, e.g. "pass show openrouter-api-key | head -n 1".

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort sent to the model. Omit for the model's default. none turns thinking off where supported; xhigh is not supported by every model; max is Anthropic only.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per response. Default: 32000.

cache_control.description: Send prompt cache breakpoints on the openai API (needed for Claude and some other models behind OpenAI-compatible APIs). Default: true for OpenRouter, false otherwise. The anthropic API always caches.

cache_ttl.description: Anthropic prompt cache TTL. Default: 1h interactive, 5m with -q. Idle compaction runs 5 minutes before it expires.

compact_at.description: Compact the conversation when the context passes this: tokens (150000, "150k", "1.5m") or a share of the context window ("80%"). Default: 150k.

compact_idle_at.description: Compaction threshold used between turns when the prompt cache is about to expire; same syntax as compact_at, capped at compact_at. Default: 100k.

context_window.description: Context window of this model, used for % thresholds and the context display. Dropped when /model switches models. Known for Claude, GPT-6 and Gemini; 200k is assumed otherwise.

max_rounds.description: Stop a turn after this many model requests. 0 means no limit interactively and 200 with -q.

show_reasoning.description: Print the model's reasoning (dim). Default: true.

read_only.description: Start in read-only mode (no write or edit, bash limited to an allowlist). shift+tab toggles it. Default: false.

read_only_allow.description: Extra command prefixes bash may run in read-only mode, e.g. ["make lint", "go test"].

bash_timeout.description: Default bash tool timeout in seconds. Default: 120.

subagent_models.description: Models the agent can pick for a subagent; /model <name> also switches to one.

subagent_efforts.description: Reasoning efforts the agent can pick for a subagent. Default: ["low", "medium", "high"].

instruction_files.description: Instruction files added to the system prompt. Relative paths are looked up in the git root and the working directory; ~ is expanded. Default: ["~/.claude/CLAUDE.md", "CLAUDE.md", "AGENTS.md", "CLAUDE.local.md"].

skill_dirs.description: Directories searched for */SKILL.md. Relative paths are looked up in the git root and the working directory. Default: ["~/.claude/skills", ".claude/skills", "~/.config/aicode/skills"].

hook_files.description: Claude Code settings files whose hooks run. Project files run only after the project is trusted. Default: ["~/.claude/settings.json", ".claude/settings.json", ".claude/settings.local.json", "~/.config/aicode/settings.json"].

mcp.description: MCP servers over stdio, by name. They start on first use; the agent finds their tools with tool_search and calls them with mcp_call.

picker.description: Shell command for the / picker: reads tab-separated items on stdin and prints the chosen line. {prompt} is replaced with the quoted prompt. Default: fzf with a 40% height.

notify_cmd.description: Shell command run when a turn ends while the terminal is not focused; {title} and {msg} become environment references. "off" disables it. Default: terminal-notifier on macOS, notify-send on Linux.

file_picker.description: Shell command opened by @: gets this directory's files on stdin (or {file}) and prints the chosen paths. {picker} expands to the picker command. "off" disables it. Default: {picker}.

history_picker.description: Shell command for ctrl+r: gets prompt history on stdin, newest first, and prints the chosen prompt. "off" disables it. Default: {picker}.

session_picker.description: Shell command for /resume and -r: gets this directory's sessions on stdin and prints the chosen line. "off" disables it. Default: {picker} with a session preview.

pager.description: Shell command /history opens the conversation with (text on stdin, or {file}). "off" disables it. Default: $PAGER, else less -R.

copy_cmd.description: Shell command /copy pipes the last answer to. "off" disables it. Default: pbcopy on macOS, wl-copy or xclip on Linux.

builtin_skills.description: List aicode's built-in skills (aicode-config, for reading and changing these settings) in the system prompt. Default: true.

providers.description: Named API endpoints. A profile or the top level selects one with provider.

profiles.description: Named profiles, selected with default_profile, -p name or /profile name. Each takes the same keys as the top level and replaces the top-level value of every key it sets. -p name also accepts a file ~/.config/aicode/<name>.json or a path.

default_profile.description: Profile used when -p is not given.

profile.description: A profile: any top-level key except profiles and default_profile.

tokens.description: A token count: a number (150000) or a string with an optional k or m suffix ("150k", "1.5m").

threshold.description: A token count (150000, "150k", "1.5m") or a share of the context window ("80%", 0-100).

base_url.description: API base URL; optional for the official OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.

api_key_shell.description: Shell command whose first output line is the API key.

cache_control.description: Send prompt cache breakpoints on the openai API. Default: true for OpenRouter, false otherwise.

name.description: Short name the agent and /model use.

provider.description: Provider for this model. Default: the provider of the profile.

use_for.description: When the agent should pick this model, shown in the subagent tool description.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the server.

description.description: What the server is for, shown to the agent so it knows when to search its tools.

tools.description: Tools the agent may find and call, as glob patterns matched against the tool name (path.Match: * any run of characters, ? one character, [a-z] a class). Empty or unset: every tool. Up to 12 exact names (no glob characters) are also listed in the tool_search description.

exclude_tools.description: Tools to hide even when tools matches them, as glob patterns like tools. Hidden tools never show in tool_search and mcp_call refuses them.
